notes:
Shuffle and repeat, and they behave the way you would expect.

SHUFFLE AND REPEAT ON NOW PLAYING. Two new controls either side of the transport buttons. Shuffle on or off; repeat cycles off, then the whole queue, then the one track. They light up white when they are on.

THEY LAST FOR WHAT YOU ARE PLAYING, AND NO LONGER. Shuffle an album, then put on something else, and the something else plays in order. Sonos itself does not work this way - it keeps shuffle on until you notice and turn it off - so Sorriva clears it every time new music is loaded.

MOVE THE MUSIC AND THE SETTING MOVES WITH IT. Send what you are playing to another room and it arrives still shuffled. That is the one case where the setting should follow you, and it does.

NOT SHOWN ON RADIO, RATHER THAN SHOWN AND DEAD. A radio station has nothing to shuffle, so the controls are simply not there and Now Playing looks exactly as it did before.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE. You cannot yet set shuffle on an album or playlist before pressing play - the controls live on Now Playing only. That waits for Sorriva to have a real queue you can see.

ALSO THIS SESSION, ON PAPER RATHER THAN ON SCREEN: the design for putting Apple Music into your library properly - albums and playlists saved alongside your own FLAC, with the same things you can do to them - and the discovery that Sorriva records nothing at all about the quality of your local files. It knows a track is FLAC and how big it is, and cannot tell 16/44.1 from 24/192. Fixing that is first up next time.
